$comment: Machine-readable rights ledger for the tabletop systems issue #200 names as design influences on the NooPunk rules kernel. Purpose: record, per source, what its license actually is, what may be reused, and what may not -- BEFORE any rule text is ported into a Creative Commons NooPunk. Companion to data/sources/external_sources.json (issue #60), which covers the Eclipse Phase reference set; this file covers the Fudge/Fate/PbtA/OSR set plus the closed systems #200 removes. This file records LICENSE FINDINGS ONLY. No rule text, table, formula or artwork from any source here has been imported. Every 'license_checked' date is a real-world observation date, not in-world canon.
$retrieved_convention: Real-world metadata dates. AGENTS.md section 6 limits in-world future dates to 20XX; this file makes no in-world claims.

author_direction.decision: NooPunk will be fully Creative Commons (author decision, 2026-10-10).
author_direction.supersedes: Earlier #200 language treating Cyberpunk RED as the mechanics baseline, and any implication that OGL material can simply be relicensed CC.
author_direction.design_geometry: Equilateral GNS triangle: Simulationism ~33.33% (Eclipse Phase), Narrativism ~33.33% (Apocalypse World / The Veil), Gamism ~33.33% (Cities Without Number / Stars Without Number). Proportions are playtest goals, not page quotas. No influence is ranked above another.
author_direction.center: One NooPunk system homebrewed from Fudge + Psi-Punk + Fate + Transhumanity's Fate together. Separate Attributes and Skills (Fudge's distinction) are NOT optional; the six STATs FIT/REF/INT/SOC/CYB/PSY and the existing Skill catalogue survive.
author_direction.not_yet_done: This issue is a specification. No code or rulebook text has migrated merely because this ledger exists.

target_license.$comment: Itemized: the rulebook/setting and the code are licensed separately, and the choice is the author's.

rulebook_and_original_setting.why: Permits commercial and non-commercial modification, requires attribution and reciprocity, and accepts adaptation of CC BY 3.0 and CC BY-SA 3.0 material -- which is exactly the Fate Core SRD (BY 3.0) and The Veil (BY-SA 3.0) pathway.
rulebook_and_original_setting.alternative_cost: Maximum permissive reuse, but then CC BY-SA expression (e.g. The Veil) must NOT be directly adapted.

code.license: separate software license (MIT, Apache-2.0 or GPL)
code.why: A CC license is not a software license; source code must be licensed and attributed separately.

target_license.status: RECOMMENDED, NOT RATIFIED -- requires explicit author selection before any porting.

decision_vocabulary.verified-permissive: License read directly at the authoritative source. Adaptation is permitted with attribution; the source is compatible with a commercially reusable CC release.
decision_vocabulary.verified-public-domain: A verified CC0 / public-domain dedication. No attribution obligation, but verify the SCOPE -- an SRD is not the full commercial book.
decision_vocabulary.verified-nc-sharealike: Verified NonCommercial + ShareAlike. Its expression CANNOT enter a commercially reusable CC BY or BY-SA release. Independent implementation of described ideas only.
decision_vocabulary.no-cc-grant-established: No Creative Commons grant found. This is not a finding that reuse is forbidden; it is a finding that reuse of expression is NOT permitted on this evidence. Implement concepts independently, copy nothing.
decision_vocabulary.blocked-unverified: The authoritative page could not be read. Recorded as a blocked verification, NOT as a negative result: nothing may be asserted about the terms either way, and nothing may be imported.
decision_vocabulary.proprietary-out-of-scope: Closed/proprietary rules. Must not remain a base, an implementation source, or an attribution/reuse dependency for NooPunk rules. Abstract design lessons and genre/interaction references are permitted; no text, tables, formulas, code, assets or worlds.

sources.attribution: Fate Core System (c) Evil Hat Productions, LLC -- CC BY 3.0 Unported
sources.role_in_noopunk: Narrativist machinery: aspects, invokes/compels, stress and consequences, scene-level stakes.
sources.how_verified: Read directly from the SRD page, which states the material is 'licensed for our use under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported license'. The same page carries the same statement for Fate System Toolkit and Fate Accelerated.
sources.notes: Attribution required. CC BY 3.0 text may be adapted into a CC BY-SA 4.0 work (one-way compatibility), but the resulting work is BY-SA. The site itself is (c) Amazing Rando Design 'except where otherwise noted' -- the site chrome is not the licensed rules text.

sources.license: OGL 1.0a for designated Open Game Content
sources.role_in_noopunk: First-rank STRUCTURAL inspiration: the separate Attribute/Skill split and flexible quantitative adjudication. Nothing else.
sources.how_verified: CONFLICTING OBSERVATIONS, both recorded. A sibling agent (#205) read the publisher page and reports it states the SRD is released under the OGL, that Appendix I carries OGL 1.0a, and lists the three compliance obligations. This environment COULD NOT VERIFY: fudgerpg.com returns HTTP 403 at the licensing page and HTTP 406 (Mod_Security) at the site root, and the Wayback Machine reports no archived snapshot. The publisher's assertion is therefore recorded as REPORTED-BUT-NOT-INDEPENDENTLY-REPRODUCED rather than silently accepted or discarded.
sources.notes: Even when verified, OGL 1.0a Open Game Content is NOT a Creative Commons grant and cannot be relabelled or relicensed CC. OGL 1.0a also carries obligations incompatible with a pure CC release. Treat as design inspiration ONLY unless the author secures separate written CC-compatible permission. The Fudge OGL and the 1995 Fudge PDF are two different licences -- do not conflate them.

sources.license: special limited free-distribution licence (author-stated), NOT CC
sources.role_in_noopunk: Historical reference for the trait ladder and the attribute/skill distinction.
sources.how_verified: Not verified -- the material is not present on disk and the publisher site is unreachable from this environment.
sources.notes: Its own restrictive free-distribution terms are not a blanket CC grant. Do not copy its wording or tables into a CC-only rulebook.

sources.license: OGL 1.0a for designated Open Game Content, with declared Product Identity
sources.role_in_noopunk: The proof-of-concept that psychic, cyber and astral subsystems can be built around a Fudge-style attribute/skill split.
sources.how_verified: Reported by a sibling agent (#205), which read the SRD legal page: it names the reserved material ('All content in the game's Introduction and in Chapter 1: The World of Psi-punk are considered Product Identity. Brain.Net, the sample adventure, is likewise ...'), and the publisher's announcement describes the SRD as the rules text with 'virtually none of the setting or fluff'. NOT independently reproduced from this environment; recorded as reported rather than as read.
sources.notes: TWO separate exclusions apply: OGL Open Game Content is not CC and must not be relabelled, and the declared Product Identity is not open at all. Its structural lessons are implementable; its tables are not. Design/structural inspiration only unless separate written permission is obtained.

sources.role_in_noopunk: Simulationist influence: cyberware, networks, AI, PSI, transhumanism, equipment, tactical conflict, cross-realm interaction.
sources.how_verified: Verified from the publisher's licence page in issue #60; see data/sources/external_sources.json.
sources.notes: NonCommercial + ShareAlike. Its expression CANNOT enter a commercially reusable CC BY or BY-SA release. Independent text and mechanics only, as #200 requires.

sources.role_in_noopunk: The demonstration that a sophisticated transhuman setting runs on Fate.
sources.how_verified: Recorded in issue #60's audit as NOT PRESENT on disk; the licence is the author's statement, not an independent reading.
sources.notes: NonCommercial. Protected text cannot go into a commercially reusable CC edition. If the author supplies the file, it needs its own dated entry before any content is used.

sources.source: Cities Without Number System Reference Document (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine)
sources.role_in_noopunk: Gamist influence: fast procedures, generators, mission structure, encounter pacing, cyberpunk skill framing.
sources.how_verified: Three readings agree. (1) The publisher's own storefront listing: 'provided under a Creative Commons 0 waiver allowing downloaders to copy, modify, reproduce, or otherwise use it for both personal and commercial purposes. Later versions of this file may be released, but any released version may be used'. (2) The publisher blurb as carried by the SRD's aggregator listings. (3) The SRD mirror: 'The SRD is a free, open-source, and public domain document'. The gordianblade viewer renders client-side, so its own licence text could not be read as static HTML -- hence the storefront quote is the load-bearing evidence.
sources.notes: SCOPE MATTERS: the CC0 dedication covers the SYSTEM REFERENCE DOCUMENT. It is not a finding that the full commercial Cities Without Number book is CC0 -- 'the full SRD, but not all parts of the original book'. Use only the SRD, and only the parts it actually covers.

sources.source: Stars Without Number (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine)
sources.license: NOT ESTABLISHED from an authoritative source
sources.role_in_noopunk: Gamist influence: generators, faction turns, sandbox procedures.
sources.how_verified: NOT VERIFIED, and deliberately not promoted. Third-party reports and the publisher's sibling listings for CWN and Worlds Without Number both describe a Creative Commons 0 waiver, but the SWN SRD's own publisher listing was not located in either pass (this environment was rate-limited at HTTP 202; a sibling agent, #205, recorded the same gap).
sources.notes: Downgraded to principles-only precisely because #200 forbids treating 'user reports CC' as a finding. NooPunk must not list the whole book as CC on this evidence. Promote to a reusable verdict ONLY after reading the SWN SRD's own licence page, and record it as a separate entry clearly distinguished from the commercial book.

sources.source: Apocalypse World (D. Vincent and Meguey Baker)
sources.license: NO CC GRANT ESTABLISHED -- all rights reserved with a per-request permission policy for words
sources.role_in_noopunk: Narrativist influence: fiction-first stakes, hard choices, GM moves, clocks, social and emotional consequences.
sources.how_verified: The publisher's PbtA policy page, read by a sibling agent (#205): 'If you're using our words, you need our permission, per copyright law. If you aren't using our words, you don't need our permission'. This environment separately confirmed the absence of any CC statement on the publisher's own Apocalypse World pages. Being the origin of the PbtA design movement, and appearing in free references, does not establish a CC grant for the book.
sources.notes: The policy is permission-per-request, not a standing grant -- which is exactly why the practical route is INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATION of the concepts and reuse of none of the words. 'PbtA' is a descriptive design designation, not a licence, and NooPunk is not required to use PbtA's dice mechanic.

sources.source: The Veil / The Veil: Cascade (Samjoko Publishing)
sources.role_in_noopunk: Narrativist influence: emotional stakes, identity, cyberpunk-PbtA framing.
sources.how_verified: The work's own licence statement ('The text of The Veil: Cascade is licensed under the Creative Commons Share-alike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0)'), found in two independent copies and reported by a sibling agent (#205); the publisher's own site was not fetched in either pass. The material itself is not present on disk (#60 records the same absence).
sources.notes: THE DECISIVE CASE FOR BY-SA OVER BY-ONLY: CC BY-SA 3.0 is compatible with a CC BY-SA 4.0 release through the one-way 3.0-to-4.0 upgrade, and incompatible with a CC BY-only release. CAVEAT that survives the verification: the work's own text records that some moves are 'tweaked or lifted straight from Apocalypse World ... used with his permission'. That permission was granted to THAT project and does not transfer to NooPunk, so the AW-derived portions inside The Veil are NOT covered by The Veil's licence. The grant covers The Veil's own text.

open_inconsistency.$comment: Found while combining the sibling work. PARTLY REPAIRED by PR #208 and re-verified against main. What remains is REPORTED, not silently fixed, because it sits inside the author-owned set.
open_inconsistency.repaired: PR #208 moved the numbered invariant list in docs/archive/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md onto the issue #200 triangle poles and updated tests/test_design_principles.py with it, so that document no longer argues two sets of poles with itself.
open_inconsistency.what_remains: AGENTS.md section 13.2 still names CY_BORG (Gamism), Cyberpunk 2020 (Simulationism) and The Sprawl (Narrativism) as the canonical reference poles, while docs/archive/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md item 2 now names Eclipse Phase / Apocalypse World & The Veil / Cities Without Number & Stars Without Number and points at the #200 triangle in its own section 1. The contradiction did not disappear -- it moved from inside one document to between two.
open_inconsistency.why_it_matters: tests/test_design_principles.py passes on this revision, so the build still does not catch it. The guard pins the principles document; AGENTS.md is the canonical repository contract and is author-owned.
open_inconsistency.author_action: AGENTS.md sections 13.2 and 15.3 need revising in the same deliberate pass as the rest of the author-owned set, per #200's 'author-approved process'. Until then this ledger records the contradiction instead of resolving it.

reuse_rules.$comment: The gates that make this ledger enforceable rather than decorative.
reuse_rules.cc0: Usable in any NooPunk release, commercial or not. Scope-limited: an SRD dedication does not cover its full commercial book.
reuse_rules.cc_by_3_0: Adaptable with attribution. One-way compatible into a CC BY-SA 4.0 work.
reuse_rules.cc_by_sa_3_0: Adaptable with attribution, ShareAlike. Compatible with a CC BY-SA 4.0 release only, not with CC BY-only.
reuse_rules.cc_by_nc_sa: NOT usable in a commercially reusable CC BY or BY-SA release. Independent implementation of described ideas only.
reuse_rules.ogl_1_0a: NOT a CC grant and not relabellable as CC. Obligations are incompatible with a pure CC release. Design inspiration only absent separate written permission.
reuse_rules.proprietary: No copying of any kind. Abstract design lessons and genre references only.
reuse_rules.public_availability_is_not_a_license: Being downloadable, having an SRD, appearing on GitHub, or being free does not equal a Creative Commons grant.
reuse_rules.amount_recycled: How much was reused matters for identifying an adaptation, but small changes do not remove a licence restriction.
reuse_rules.ideas_vs_expression: Implementing a described game procedure is not copying the expression of it. This distinction is the whole basis on which NooPunk may be CC while inspired by OGL and NC systems.

authority_conflict.$comment: HERMES.md: when a task conflicts with a locked element, preserve the lock and report the conflict.
authority_conflict.what: AGENTS.md section 13 (design balances) and section 15 (independent-system rule) are author-owned. Section 13.8 forbids silently redesigning the balances; section 13.9 and section 15.2 fix issue #111's 1-10 STAT + 1-10 Skill + 1d10 core as the active baseline; section 13.2 fixes the CY_BORG/Cyberpunk 2020/The Sprawl poles.
authority_conflict.why_it_blocks: Issue #200 supersedes the framing and replaces the poles, and its own text says to 'Update AGENTS.md/locked-rule policy by author-approved process'. It is not an agent decision.

migration_order.$comment: The order #200 implies, so that no step outruns its authorisation.
migration_order.1_audit: DONE, and now consolidated. This ledger, the claim inventory, the reconciliation of the parallel sibling audits, and the exact-probability method adopted from the sibling lab.
migration_order.2_license_choice: Author selects CC BY-SA 4.0 or CC BY 4.0 and publishes LICENSE/NOTICE/attribution map with itemized surfaces. The Veil (CC BY-SA 3.0) makes this consequential: BY-SA keeps that adaptation path open, BY-only forfeits it.
migration_order.3_authority_update: Author updates AGENTS.md sections 13/15 + docs/archive/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md + tests/test_design_principles.py together, explicitly superseding the pole and baseline language -- and thereby resolving the open_inconsistency recorded above.
migration_order.4_reword_claims: Update the live files in the inventory above. Audit before deleting; preserve original NooPunk text and lore; no destructive blanket deletions.
migration_order.4b_ep_prototype_quarantine: Before any public release, inventory and fence the Eclipse Phase 2E homebrew prototype (src/eclipse_phase_homebrew/, src/concordia_runtime/ep2_adapter.py). It is CC BY-NC-SA-derived and must not ship inside a commercially reusable CC release. See docs/licenses/ISSUE_200_CC_RELEASE_GATE.md and docs/licenses/ECLIPSE_PHASE_HOMEBREW.md -- do not delete it while tests depend on it.
migration_order.5_kernel_prototype: TEST RIG DELIVERED, not a migration: src/rules/kernel_prototype.py tests three candidate combination rules against the canonical 1d10 benchmark, with measurements in docs/design/ISSUE_200_KERNEL_PROTOTYPE.md. The sibling lab in src/rules/issue200_resolution_lab.py covers the raw-scale comparison exactly. No formula is locked and the canonical d10 implementation is untouched.
migration_order.6_migrate_legacy: Migrate the historical 1d10 code only AFTER the decision, keeping the six STATs and the Skill taxonomy and specialist policy.
migration_order.7_subsystems: Rework Physical/Social/Cyber/Psychic/Astral/NHI/Investigative subsystems in CC-compatible original drafting.
migration_order.8_gates: Reproducible tests, licence scan and valid attribution before the issue is marked done; add checks that flag unreviewed third-party material and block reintroduction of excluded licences.

current_imports.summary: None. No rule text, table, formula or artwork from any source in this ledger has been imported into NooPunk.
